name: brave-search
title_zh: 不打开浏览器，直接搜网页并抓正文
tagline_zh: 查文档、找事实、抓网页内容，一条命令搞定。不用开浏览器、不用手动复制，轻量到像在终端里打了个响指。
tagline_en: Search the web and pull page content without opening a browser. Docs, facts, anything—one command, zero tab.
desc_en: Web search and content extraction via Brave Search API. Use for searching documentation, facts, or any web content. Lightweight, no browser required.
why_zh: 它把搜索和正文提取焊成一步，省掉“搜完再点进去复制”的中间态。对脚本和自动化来说，这是唯一不卡壳的路径。
why_en: It fuses search and content extraction into one step, killing the copy-paste middleman. For scripts and automation, it's the.
limit_zh: 必须自备 Brave Search API key，且免费额度有限（每月约 2000 次）。只返回文本，不处理登录墙。
limit_en: Requires your own Brave Search API key with a ~2k/month free cap. Text only—no login walls, JS-rendered pages, or PDFs.
